faqs.a:
Employees may not solicit any other employee during working time. The only exception
               is city sponsored activities or products. With the approval of the employee's appointing
               authority, an employee may place fund-raising information in a city break room or
               may post information on a designated electronic or physical bulletin board. The appointing
               authority reserves the right to refuse to post any item. Under no circumstances may
               an employee disturb the work of others to solicit, e-mail, or distribute literature
               to them during their working time, including fund-raising activities.
(
Ord. No. 4862
, § 1, 10-16-2023)
